newsitem.title: UK: Ashanti says Anglo relations are cordial.
newsitem.headline: Ashanti says Anglo relations are cordial.

text.p: Ashanti Goldfields said relations with South African powerhouse and indirect shareholder Anglo American were cordial, although no discussions were going on co-operation in any areas.
"We have a cordial relationship with the Anglo board as with other major mining firms," Ashanti's finance director Mark Keatly told journalists.

But "they have not made any specific suggestions", Keatly said when asked whether Anglo had come up with co-operation proposals after the South African firm had said earlier it might be constructive to work together.
Anglo recently raised its take in Lonrho to 28 percent, making it the biggest shareholder of the British conglomerate which in turn holds 33.6 percent of Ashanti.
